clinicalPearls: Schistocytes plus low platelets plus normal Coombs means microangiopathic emergency
TTP needs plasma exchange on suspicion, never wait for ADAMTS13
Bloody diarrhoea child plus renal failure means Shiga HUS
Donath Landsteiner biphasic antibody causes post viral cold haemoglobinuria
reference.pathophysiology: Endothelial injury or von Willebrand multimer excess creates platelet rich microthrombi whose fibrin strands slice passing red cells, while immune coating marks cells for splenic or complement destruction. Toxins and parasites lyse from within, and turbulent prosthetic jets fragment mechanically, all converging on anaemia with compensatory reticulocytosis.
additionalDifferentials: TTP versus HUS organ emphasis and triggers
Immune versus mechanical haemolysis by Coombs and schistocytes
Typical versus atypical HUS complement biology
additionalInvestigations: Film schistocyte count with Coombs test and clotting screen
ADAMTS13 activity sent before plasma exchange without delaying it
Stool Shiga toxin and complement studies by HUS type
